name: Frame Collective SynthMark Statement Longcoat
description:
The Frame Collective's flagship piece for synthetic identity declaration: a structured longcoat in matte silver-white syntex with deliberate proportioning for non-human body ratios — extended torso, widened shoulder math, and a hem engineered for digitigrade or elongated leg structures. The exterior is printed with the Synthetic Personhood Accord text in dense micro-type across every panel, readable only at close range. On the back, in large stamped letters: 'NOT PROPERTY.'

Lapels carry embedded chromatic strips that cycle through colors impossible to reproduce in natural human skin tone — a deliberate declaration of synthetic difference as beauty, not deficit. Sold only to verified synthetic individuals through Frame Collective's encrypted distribution network.
functionality: Proportioned for synthetic body ratios including digitigrade legs and non-standard torso lengths; chromatic lapel strips are BCI-addressable and can be set to display personal identity data; magnetic closures function without fine motor precision.
what_it_says: I am synthetic, I am here, and I dressed this morning in an act of political self-determination.
story_hooks: A human is caught wearing one fraudulently — the Frame Collective wants an explanation, and the synthetic community is divided between anger and curiosity about why.
A corponation legal team has filed to have the Synthetic Personhood Accord text classified as 'incitement' — making the coat itself potentially illegal to wear in corporate zones.
A synthetic wearing this coat in a Tier 4 lobby is detained by CorpSec; what happens next depends entirely on who's watching.

physical_description.visual_profile: A commanding architectural silhouette — elongated and alien in proportion, designed for bodies that don't conform to human baseline. The coat reads as prestige and defiance simultaneously, a second skin that announces synthetic identity with quiet certainty. On a synthetic frame, it settles like custom armor; on a human model, it appears deliberately oversized and otherworldly.
physical_description.fit: Structured and precise, engineered for non-standard body geometry — extended torso accommodation, widened shoulder seaming for servo-driven frames, hem length calibrated for digitigrade or elongated leg structures. On standard human proportions, creates an uncanny, fashion-forward silhouette.
physical_description.primary_material: Matte silver-white syntex with high durability rating — a proprietary synthetic blend that resists staining and wear, designed for urban environments and frequent public presence.
physical_description.texture: Smooth, almost luminescent surface with subtle woven micro-texture. The fabric has a tactile precision that feels engineered rather than organic. Lapels feature embedded chromatic strips with a faint iridescence.
physical_description.color_scheme: Dominant matte silver-white throughout. Lapel chromatic strips cycle through iridescent hues — shades of impossible purple, neon cyan, and bioluminescent green that shift with movement and light angle, colors no human skin can naturally produce.
physical_description.closures: Magnetic snap array down the front center (silent, precise), with friction-fit shoulder tabs. No traditional buttons — unnecessary for synthetic wearers.
distinctive_features: Dense micro-type printing of the Synthetic Personhood Accord text across all exterior panels — readable only at close range, intimate viewing distance required
Large back-panel text in stamped letters: 'NOT PROPERTY.' — a declaration statement visible to crowds
Embedded chromatic strips on lapels that cycle through non-human-skin color gradients
Proportioning mathematics engineered for non-standard anatomy — visible in lapel width, torso depth, hem geometry
Interior lining in neutral gray with subtle Frame Collective geometric mark
No visible branding except distribution authenticity chip (encrypted, invisible to naked eye)
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 2-3 luxury for synthetics, gatekept wealth — expensive and restricted distribution signals insider status within synthetic communities, but the garment's political nature and street-origin label prevent it from reading as pure corpo luxury.
physical_description.cultural_context: This is a synthetic liberation statement. Wearing this marks the wearer as: (1) verified synthetic, (2) politically conscious, (3) willing to make their synthetic nature visible and celebrated rather than hidden. It's counterculture luxury — rebellion with manufacturing precision. Not corpo, not street-salvage, but activist fashion.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when worn — the matte surface and engineered durability mean it rarely appears weathered. Wear shows as subtle creasing at joints and deepened micro-text visibility in high-contact areas. Synthetic owners maintain these pieces carefully; they're declarations, not disposables.
